en.title: Free Wispr Flow alternative for Mac — TypeAloud
en.description: TypeAloud is a free Wispr Flow alternative that transcribes on your Mac: no weekly word cap, no account, no subscription, and it keeps working offline.
heading: A free Wispr Flow alternative
that runs on your Mac.
en.intro: Wispr Flow's free plan stops at 2,000 words a week on desktop. TypeAloud transcribes on your own Mac instead, so there is no word cap to hit, no account to create and nothing to subscribe to.

table.caption: TypeAloud and Wispr Flow compared
rows: Free plan; Pro at $15/month, or $12/month billed annually
Free plan: 2,000 words a week on desktop, 1,000 on mobile
On your Mac, in local mode
Yes, after a one-time model download
No. It writes what you said

sections.heading: Why the word cap disappears
body: Wispr Flow sends each recording to its servers, and every dictated word costs it compute. That is what the weekly cap and the Pro plan pay for.

TypeAloud downloads a speech model once (Qwen3-ASR 0.6B, about 1 GB) and runs it on your Mac. After that, dictating 200 words or 20,000 words in a week costs nobody anything, so there is no quota to enforce.

sections.heading: The same hold, speak, release habit
body: Hold Ctrl+Shift in whatever app you are writing in, speak, and release. The text lands at your cursor: in your editor, your terminal, Slack, a browser field. Escape cancels a recording.
Finished transcripts are kept in History on your device. If a transcription fails and the audio was saved, you can retry it.

sections.heading: Where Wispr Flow is the better choice
body: Wispr Flow rewrites what you say: it drops filler words, fixes self-corrections and adjusts tone to the app you are in. TypeAloud gives you an accurate transcript of what you said and leaves the wording to you.
Wispr Flow also has iPhone and Android apps and team plans. TypeAloud is a desktop app, tested mainly on macOS. If you dictate on your phone or need shared team dictionaries, Wispr Flow fits better.

faq.q: Is TypeAloud really free?
faq.a: Yes. Local transcription needs no account, API key or subscription, and there is no word limit. Cloud transcription is optional and uses your own Groq or OpenAI key, which those providers may charge for.

faq.q: Does my audio leave my Mac?
faq.a: Not in local mode. The model runs on your device and transcripts are saved there. Audio is only uploaded if you choose a cloud engine with your own API key.

faq.q: Which Macs can run it?
faq.a: Apple Silicon is recommended for local dictation. The recommended model is a one-time download of about 1 GB.

faq.q: Is there a Windows version?
faq.a: There are Windows and Linux builds, but they are experimental. macOS is the platform TypeAloud is tested on.

sections.heading: 为什么可以不限字数
body: Wispr Flow 每次录音都要上传到它的服务器，你说的每个词都在消耗它的算力，每周上限和 Pro 订阅就是为这个付费。
TypeAloud 只下载一次语音模型（Qwen3-ASR 0.6B，约 1 GB），之后就在你的 Mac 上运行。一周说 200 词还是 2 万词，都不产生任何费用，也就没有额度可言。

sections.heading: 一样是按住、说话、松开
body: 在正在写字的应用里按住 Ctrl+Shift，说话，松开，文字就出现在光标处：编辑器、终端、微信、飞书、浏览器输入框都一样。按 Esc 可以取消录音。
完成的转写会保存在本机的历史记录里。如果转写失败而录音已保存，可以重新转写。

sections.heading: 哪些情况下 Wispr Flow 更合适
body: Wispr Flow 会改写你说的话：去掉口头禅，处理改口，并按当前应用调整语气。TypeAloud 给你的是准确的逐字转写，措辞由你自己决定。
Wispr Flow 还有 iPhone 和 Android 应用，以及团队版。TypeAloud 是桌面应用，主要在 macOS 上测试。如果你主要在手机上听写，或者需要团队共享词典，Wispr Flow 更合适。

faq.q: TypeAloud 真的免费吗？
faq.a: 是的。本地转写不需要账号、API key 或订阅，也没有字数限制。云端转写是可选项，使用你自己的 Groq 或 OpenAI key，这些服务商可能会收费。

faq.q: 我的录音会离开 Mac 吗？
faq.a: 本地模式下不会。模型在你的设备上运行，转写结果也保存在本机。只有当你选择云端引擎并填入自己的 API key 时，音频才会上传。

faq.q: 哪些 Mac 可以运行？
faq.a: 本地听写推荐使用 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac。推荐模型只需下载一次，约 1 GB。

faq.q: 有 Windows 版吗？
faq.a: 有 Windows 和 Linux 版本，但目前是实验性的。TypeAloud 主要在 macOS 上测试。

en.title: Typeless alternative that works offline — TypeAloud
en.description: Looking for a Typeless alternative? TypeAloud is free voice typing for Mac that transcribes on your device: no subscription, no word limit, no audio upload.
heading: A Typeless alternative
that works offline, for free.
en.intro: Typeless is a cloud voice keyboard with a weekly word limit on its free plan and a $12 to $30 monthly Pro plan. TypeAloud does the transcription on your Mac, so it is free, unlimited and still works with Wi-Fi off.

sections.heading: What you keep, what you give up
body: The core habit is the same in both apps: hold a shortcut, talk, and the text appears in the app you were already using. In TypeAloud the shortcut is Ctrl+Shift and the text is inserted at your cursor.
What Typeless adds is editing. It removes filler words, tidies repetition and formats lists for you. TypeAloud does not rewrite your speech, so what you get is a transcript of what you actually said.

sections.heading: Your dictation stays on your device
body: Typeless states that it keeps no cloud data after processing. Your audio still has to travel to a server to be transcribed. In TypeAloud's local mode the audio never leaves your Mac at all, which matters when you dictate client names, medical notes or unreleased work.
It also means dictation keeps working on a plane, on a train, or on a network that blocks cloud services.

sections.heading: Good with mixed Chinese and English
body: TypeAloud's local model is Qwen3-ASR, which detects the spoken language on its own. You can say a sentence that switches between Chinese and English without changing any setting first.

faq.q: Is TypeAloud a full replacement for Typeless?
faq.a: For dictating text into any Mac app, yes. It does not have Typeless's AI rewriting or its phone apps.

faq.q: How much does TypeAloud cost?
faq.a: Nothing. Local transcription has no subscription and no word limit. An optional cloud mode uses your own Groq or OpenAI API key.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.a: No. Download the app, pick a local model and start dictating. There is no account.

faq.q: What does it need to run?
faq.a: A Mac, ideally with Apple Silicon, about 1 GB for the recommended model, plus microphone and Accessibility permissions.

en.title: Free, open-source Superwhisper alternative for Mac — TypeAloud
en.description: TypeAloud is a free, open-source Superwhisper alternative: local dictation on your Mac with no Pro plan and no account, built for sentences that mix Chinese and English.
heading: A Superwhisper alternative
with nothing behind a Pro plan.
en.intro: Superwhisper's free plan already runs Whisper on your Mac. Its Pro plan, at $8.49 a month, $84.99 a year or $249.99 once, adds AI modes, cloud models and more local models. TypeAloud is free and open source with no paid tier, and its local model is Qwen3-ASR instead of Whisper.

sections.heading: Both are local. The model is the difference.
body: Superwhisper's free plan and TypeAloud both transcribe on your Mac with no word limit, so price alone does not decide it. What you dictate does.

TypeAloud runs Qwen3-ASR, which works out the language from the audio itself. A sentence that starts in Chinese and switches to English halfway is written down as you said it, with no language setting to change first. Whisper picks one language per recording, and mixed sentences are where it slips most often.

sections.heading: Every feature is in the free app
body: There is no Pro plan to unlock. The larger Qwen3-ASR 1.7B model (about 2.52 GB), the dictionary and automatic replacements, History with retry for failed transcriptions, and the optional cloud mode with your own Groq or OpenAI key are all part of the same free download.
The source is on GitHub under GPL-3.0, so you can check exactly what happens to your audio.

sections.heading: Where Superwhisper is the better choice
body: Superwhisper's Pro modes rewrite what you say into an email, a message or your own format, and Super Mode adapts to what is on screen. TypeAloud gives you a faithful transcript and leaves the wording to you.
Superwhisper also records meetings, transcribes audio files and has iPhone and Android apps. If you need those, or want your speech turned into finished prose, Superwhisper fits better.

faq.q: Is TypeAloud free in the same way as Superwhisper's free plan?
faq.a: TypeAloud has no paid plan at all. Local transcription, both Qwen3-ASR model sizes and every feature are free. Optional cloud transcription uses your own Groq or OpenAI key, which those providers may charge for.

faq.q: Can I still use Whisper?
faq.a: Not as a local model. Locally TypeAloud runs Qwen3-ASR. Whisper is available through the optional cloud mode, with your own Groq or OpenAI API key.

faq.q: Does my audio leave my Mac?
faq.a: Not in local mode. The model runs on your device and transcripts are saved there. Audio is only uploaded if you choose a cloud engine with your own API key.

faq.q: Which Macs can run it?
faq.a: Apple Silicon is recommended for local dictation. The recommended model is a one-time download of about 1 GB.

en.title: Free VoiceInk alternative for Mac — TypeAloud

heading: A VoiceInk alternative
that costs nothing, on every Mac.
en.intro: VoiceInk is a well-made local dictation app for Mac, sold as a one-time licence from $25 for one Mac. TypeAloud also transcribes on your Mac and is open source, but it is free and has no device limit.

sections.heading: Same idea, different speech model
body: Both apps keep your voice on your Mac: hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands at your cursor. In TypeAloud the shortcut is Ctrl+Shift, and a double tap records hands-free until the next press.

The difference is the model underneath. VoiceInk uses Whisper and Parakeet. Parakeet's multilingual model covers European languages, not Chinese. TypeAloud uses Qwen3-ASR, which detects the language from the audio and handles a sentence that moves between Chinese and English without a setting change.

sections.heading: No licence to count
body: VoiceInk's licences are per device: one, two or three Macs. TypeAloud is free, so a work Mac, a home Mac and an old laptop cost the same as one. It also has Windows and Linux builds, though those are still experimental.

sections.heading: Where VoiceInk is the better choice
body: VoiceInk can clean up what you say with an AI pass, removing filler words and formatting text, and it can rewrite selected text from a spoken instruction. TypeAloud gives you a faithful transcript and leaves the wording to you.
VoiceInk also has an iOS app and a large community behind it. If you dictate mostly in English and want AI cleanup on top, VoiceInk is worth its price.

faq.q: Is TypeAloud really free?
faq.a: Yes. Local transcription needs no account, API key, licence or subscription, and there is no word limit. Cloud transcription is optional and uses your own Groq or OpenAI key, which those providers may charge for.

faq.q: Are both apps open source?
faq.a: Both publish their source on GitHub. TypeAloud is GPL-3.0, and its signed builds are free to download.

faq.q: Does my audio leave my Mac?
faq.a: Not in local mode. The model runs on your device and transcripts are saved there. Audio is only uploaded if you choose a cloud engine with your own API key.

faq.q: Which Macs can run it?
faq.a: Apple Silicon is recommended for local dictation. The recommended model is a one-time download of about 1 GB.

macOS; Windows and Linux builds are experimental

sections.heading: Chinese and English in one sentence
body: Spokenly runs Whisper and Parakeet on your device. Parakeet's multilingual model covers European languages, not Chinese, and Whisper picks one language per recording.

TypeAloud's local model, Qwen3-ASR, works out the language from the audio. That suits the way a lot of technical work in Chinese sounds: Chinese grammar around English product names, API names and half the nouns, all in one breath.

sections.heading: Source you can read
body: TypeAloud is GPL-3.0 on GitHub. When it says local mode keeps your audio on your Mac, you can check the code that records it, transcribes it and saves it to History.
It also does one job: dictation into the app you are using. There is no Pro plan, so there is nothing to upsell inside the app.

sections.heading: Where Spokenly is the better choice
body: Spokenly can pass your transcript through GPT, Claude or Gemini with modes and instructions, run voice-controlled actions on macOS, record meetings and work as an iPhone keyboard. TypeAloud does none of these.
If you dictate mainly in English and want AI processing, an iPhone keyboard or meeting notes, Spokenly fits better.

faq.q: Both are free. Why pick TypeAloud?
faq.a: Mostly for its local model. If your dictation mixes Chinese and English, Qwen3-ASR handles that without a language setting. TypeAloud is also open source.

faq.q: Can I bring my own API key?
faq.a: Yes. Cloud transcription is optional and uses your own Groq or OpenAI key, which those providers may charge for.

faq.q: Does my audio leave my Mac?
faq.a: Not in local mode. The model runs on your device and transcripts are saved there. Audio is only uploaded if you choose a cloud engine with your own API key.

faq.q: Which Macs can run it?
faq.a: Apple Silicon is recommended for local dictation. The recommended model is a one-time download of about 1 GB.

zh.title: Spokenly 替代：开源的 Mac 本地语音输入 — TypeAloud

heading: Spokenly 的替代，
而且是开源的。
zh.intro: Spokenly 的本地转写免费、不限量、不用注册，TypeAloud 也一样。真正的区别在三处：用什么语音模型，源代码能不能看，以及转写结果上面叠了多少 AI。

sections.heading: 一句话里中英混说
body: Spokenly 在本机跑的是 Whisper 和 Parakeet。Parakeet 的多语种模型只覆盖欧洲语言，不支持中文；Whisper 每段录音只认一种语言。
TypeAloud 的本地模型千问 Qwen3-ASR 直接从声音里判断语言。很多中文技术工作就是这么说话的：中文语法，中间夹着英文产品名、API 名和一半的名词，一口气说完。

sections.heading: 源代码看得见
body: TypeAloud 以 GPL-3.0 协议开源在 GitHub 上。它说本地模式下录音不离开你的 Mac，你可以去看录音、转写、存进历史记录的那几段代码。
它也只做一件事：往你正在用的应用里听写。没有 Pro 版，应用里也就没有任何东西要推销给你。

sections.heading: 哪些情况下 Spokenly 更合适
body: Spokenly 可以把转写结果交给 GPT、Claude 或 Gemini 按模式和指令处理，能在 macOS 上执行语音指令操作，能录会议，还能当 iPhone 键盘用。这些 TypeAloud 都没有。
如果你主要说英文，又需要 AI 处理、iPhone 键盘或会议记录，Spokenly 更合适。

faq.q: 两个都免费，为什么选 TypeAloud？
faq.a: 主要是本地模型。如果你听写时中英混说，Qwen3-ASR 不用设置语言就能处理。另外 TypeAloud 是开源的。

faq.q: 能用自己的 API key 吗？
faq.a: 能。云端转写是可选项，使用你自己的 Groq 或 OpenAI key，这些服务商可能会收费。

faq.q: 我的录音会离开 Mac 吗？
faq.a: 本地模式下不会。模型在你的设备上运行，转写结果也保存在本机。只有当你选择云端引擎并填入自己的 API key 时，音频才会上传。

faq.q: 哪些 Mac 可以运行？
faq.a: 本地听写推荐使用 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac。推荐模型只需下载一次，约 1 GB。

en.title: Offline dictation for Mac — free, no account — TypeAloud
en.description: TypeAloud is free offline dictation for Mac. A speech model runs on your device, so you can dictate into any app without internet, an account or a word limit.
heading: Offline dictation for Mac.
Free, with no account.
en.intro: TypeAloud runs a speech-to-text model on your Mac. Once the model is downloaded you can turn Wi-Fi off and keep dictating into any app, for as long as you like.

sections.heading: How it works without internet
body: On first launch you choose a local model. The recommended one, Qwen3-ASR 0.6B, is a one-time download of about 1 GB. From then on, recording and transcription both happen on your device.
Hold Ctrl+Shift, speak, release. The transcript is inserted where your cursor is. A small prompt with a live waveform shows that TypeAloud is listening.

sections.heading: What stays on your Mac
body: In local mode the audio is processed on your device and transcripts are saved there. Neither is uploaded for transcription. There is no account, so there is no profile on a server tied to what you dictate.

sections.heading: What still uses the network
body: Three things: the first model download, app updates, and the cloud features if you turn them on. Cloud transcription is optional, uses your own Groq or OpenAI key and sends audio to that provider.

sections.heading: What you need
body: A Mac, with Apple Silicon recommended for local dictation. Microphone permission to record, and macOS Accessibility permission so TypeAloud can listen for the shortcut and type into other apps.

faq.q: Does it really work with no connection at all?
faq.a: Yes. After the model download, local dictation needs no network. You can test it by turning Wi-Fi off.

faq.q: Is there a limit on how much I can dictate?
faq.a: No. With a local model there is no monthly bill and no transcription quota.

faq.q: Which languages does it understand?
faq.a: The local Qwen3-ASR model detects the spoken language automatically, including sentences that mix languages.

faq.q: Does it work in every app?
faq.a: It inserts text into the app that has focus. If an app blocks insertion, the finished transcript is still in History for you to copy.

zh.title: Mac 离线语音输入：免费、无需账号 — TypeAloud
zh.description: TypeAloud 是免费的 Mac 离线语音输入工具。语音模型在本机运行，不联网也能在任意应用里语音转文字，无需账号，不限字数。
heading: Mac 离线语音输入，
免费，无需账号。
zh.intro: TypeAloud 在你的 Mac 上运行语音转文字模型。模型下载好以后，关掉 Wi-Fi 也能继续在任意应用里听写，想说多久说多久。

sections.heading: 不联网是怎么做到的
body: 第一次启动时选择一个本地模型。推荐的 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 只需下载一次，约 1 GB。之后录音和转写都在你的设备上完成。
按住 Ctrl+Shift，说话，松开，转写结果就插入光标所在的位置。录音时会出现一个带实时波形的小提示，告诉你 TypeAloud 正在听。

sections.heading: 哪些内容留在 Mac 上
body: 本地模式下，音频在你的设备上处理，转写结果也保存在本机，两者都不会为了转写而上传。TypeAloud 没有账号系统，服务器上也就没有和你听写内容关联的个人档案。

sections.heading: 哪些地方仍然会用到网络
body: 只有三处：第一次下载模型、应用更新，以及你主动开启的云端功能。云端转写是可选的，使用你自己的 Groq 或 OpenAI key，音频会发送给对应的服务商。

sections.heading: 需要什么条件
body: 一台 Mac，本地听写推荐 Apple Silicon 芯片。需要麦克风权限用来录音，还需要 macOS 辅助功能权限，这样 TypeAloud 才能监听快捷键并把文字输入到其他应用。

faq.q: 完全没有网络真的能用吗？
faq.a: 可以。模型下载完成后，本地听写不需要网络。你可以关掉 Wi-Fi 试一下。

faq.q: 听写的量有限制吗？
faq.a: 没有。使用本地模型没有月费，也没有转写额度。

faq.q: 支持哪些语言？
faq.a: 本地的 Qwen3-ASR 模型会自动识别所说的语言，一句话里混用多种语言也可以。

faq.q: 所有应用里都能用吗？
faq.a: 它会把文字插入当前获得焦点的应用。如果某个应用阻止了插入，完成的转写仍然保存在历史记录里，可以手动复制。

en.title: Chinese–English mixed dictation for Mac — TypeAloud
en.description: Dictate sentences that mix Chinese and English without switching input languages. TypeAloud transcribes on your Mac with Qwen3-ASR, free and offline.
heading: Speak Chinese and English
in the same sentence.
en.intro: Bilingual people rarely stay in one language. TypeAloud's local model detects what you are speaking as you go, so a sentence that starts in Chinese and ends in English is written down as you said it.

sections.heading: No language switch to remember
body: Most dictation tools ask you to pick a language first, then mangle anything outside it. TypeAloud's default local model, Qwen3-ASR, takes no language setting at all. It works out the language from the audio.
That fits how technical work in Chinese actually sounds: product names, API names and half the nouns are English, and the grammar around them is Chinese.

sections.heading: Built for long dictation
body: Hold Ctrl+Shift for as long as you are talking, then release. Local mode shows progress as text arrives. Completed transcripts go to History, and a failed transcription can be retried when its audio was saved, so a long recording is not lost to one error.

sections.heading: Free, on your device
body: Local transcription needs no account, subscription or API key, and has no word limit. Audio is processed on your Mac. Apple Silicon is recommended.

faq.q: Do I have to set Chinese or English before speaking?
faq.a: No. The local Qwen3-ASR model detects the spoken language automatically.

faq.q: Does it handle English terms inside Chinese sentences?
faq.a: Yes, that is the case it is designed for. Accuracy on unusual names still varies, as with any speech model.

faq.q: Is the interface available in Chinese?
faq.a: Yes. The interface language is a separate setting from the language you speak.

faq.q: Does it work offline?
faq.a: Local transcription works offline after a one-time model download of about 1 GB.

zh.title: 中英混合语音输入：一句话里中英夹杂也能转写 — TypeAloud
zh.description: 一句话里中英文混着说，不用切换输入语言。TypeAloud 用 Qwen3-ASR 在你的 Mac 上本地转写，免费，可离线使用。
heading: 中文英文，
一句话里混着说。
zh.intro: 平时说话很少只用一种语言。TypeAloud 的本地模型边听边识别你说的是什么语言，所以一句话前半句中文、后半句英文，写下来就是你说的样子。

sections.heading: 不用记着切换语言
body: 多数语音输入工具要你先选一种语言，超出这种语言的部分就识别得乱七八糟。TypeAloud 默认的本地模型 Qwen3-ASR 没有语言设置这一项，它直接从音频里判断语言。
这正好符合中文技术工作里真实的说话方式：产品名、接口名和一半的名词是英文，把它们串起来的语法是中文。

sections.heading: 为长段听写准备的
body: 说多久就按住 Ctrl+Shift 多久，说完松开。本地模式下文字会随着转写逐步出现。完成的转写进入历史记录；转写失败时只要录音已保存，就可以重新转写，一大段话不会因为一次出错就没了。

sections.heading: 免费，在你的设备上运行
body: 本地转写不需要账号、订阅或 API key，也没有字数限制。音频在你的 Mac 上处理，推荐 Apple Silicon 芯片。

faq.q: 说话前要先选中文还是英文吗？
faq.a: 不用。本地的 Qwen3-ASR 模型会自动识别所说的语言。

faq.q: 中文句子里夹的英文术语能识别吗？
faq.a: 可以，这正是它针对的场景。少见的专有名词准确率会有波动，所有语音模型都是如此。

faq.q: 界面有中文吗？
faq.a: 有。界面语言和你说话的语言是两项独立的设置。

faq.q: 能离线使用吗？
faq.a: 本地转写在下载一次约 1 GB 的模型后即可离线使用。
